{{Quote|We’re sending you the data on a group of five Bothans, including Esrca Plo’kre.''"<br />"''Plo’kre. Done. And Thyne brings with him another.|Wedge Antilles and Moruth Doole|<ref name="WG">''[[X-Wing: Wedge's Gamble]]''</ref>}}
'''Esrca Plo'kre''' was a prisoner on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kessel/Legends|Kessel]].<ref name="WG" />

When [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]], an elite [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]], came to liberate prisoners from Kessel, Plo'kre was part of the group ransomed in exchange for taking [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Zekka Thyne]].<ref name="WG" />
